items.source: Flux<*> target types are not available because non-blocking parsing is not supported, so this decoder targets only Mono<*> types. Attempting to decode to a Flux<*> will result in a UnsupportedOperationException being thrown at runtime.
items.translation: `Flux<*>` 目标类型不可用，因为不支持非阻塞解析，因此此解码器仅针对 `Mono<*>` 类型。尝试解码为 `Flux<*>` 将在运行时抛出 UnsupportedOperationException。

items.source:
Decode a data buffer to an Object of type T. This is useful for scenarios,
that distinct messages (or events) are decoded and handled individually,
in fully aggregated form.
items.translation: 将数据缓冲区解码为类型为 T 的对象。这在需要以完全聚合的形式单独解码和处理不同消息（或事件）的场景中非常有用。
